newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-News' Fox in Australia movie j/v.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-News' Fox in Australia movie j/v.

text.p: News Corp Ltd's Fox Filmed Entertainment said on Friday it would team up with Australian production house Icon productions to develop, produce and distribute movies in Australia over the next three years.

"Icon and Fox proved a winning combination working on "Braveheart" and we aim to repeat this successful experience," Fox Filmed Enterntainment Chairman and Chief Executive Peter Chernin said in a statement.
Film star Mel Gibson is a partner in Icon.
He said Fox and Icon would jointly develop movies that originated or were being develped in Australia and which Fox would like to develop in Australia.
"The films which will be released by 20th Century Fox are to be distributed in Australia via the newly established Fox/Icon label," he said.
